text:
emily-cs: HelixAI reported session context being truncated when a session resumes after a short request. They say the first few messages after resume are missing. Customer is on Dedicated, pinned model: gptx-8k-quant-v2.

sam-support: Can you paste repro steps + minimal payload? Also need their session_id and whether they hit the resume endpoint or a new session.

emily-cs: Repro steps (from HelixAI):
1) Start session A with session_id = S-3421 on dedicated cluster (region: us-west2).
2) Send short request (system + one prompt) -> get completion.
3) Wait 12s, send resume request to /v1/sessions/S-3421/reply with conversation_history omitted (expect server to rehydrate).
4) Observe reply only includes messages since last turn, prior history missing.

Sample curl they provided:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/sessions/S-3421/reply \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_helix" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"follow up", "resume": true}'
```
Logs (HelixAI snippet):
```
[2026-02-12T14:02:21Z] session S-3421 rehydrate start -> lookup kv_cache cache_key=dedicated/cluster42/S-3421
[2026-02-12T14:02:21Z] kv_cache: hit entries=3 seq_total_tokens=642
[2026-02-12T14:02:21Z] rehydrate: applied prefix tokens=0 (expected >600)
[2026-02-12T14:02:21Z] response generated tokens=54
```

emily-cs: Customer impact: production traffic sees ~30% of resumed conversations losing prior context, customer flagged as P1 for their billing customers. They can reproduce with short idle time (5-20s).

maya-pm: Thanks. Quick clarifying Qs: is this only on Dedicated? Any model fallback observed? Also what's the degradation of latency/throughput if we enable stricter rehydrate checks?

ryan-eng: Noted. Hypothesis: KV cache rehydrate race/early eviction when sequence length bookkeeping mismatches for short-lived sessions. Could be race between async serializer and cache TTL. Quick checks:
- Confirm cache_key names and lock usage.
- Reproduce locally with pinned replica and same model variant.

olivia-engr: I can spin a small dedicated-like env and try to reproduce. Requesting the exact session_id, request ids and the customer's dedicated cluster id (cluster42 above ok). Also need the SDK/agent version HelixAI uses.

emily-cs: Helix gave SDK: redwood-js v1.12.0, session_id S-3421, request ids: r-11, r-12, r-13. Cluster ID as above.

sam-support: Triage notes: severity=customer-urgent, channel=customer-success privately flagged. Recommend escalated engineering intake.

triage-bot: Created ticket RW-5343 with labels: customer-urgent, dedicated, kv-cache; assigned to eng-oncall. Link: https://rwd/issue/RW-5343

maya-pm: For prioritization: if reproducible, we should aim for hotfix rollback within 48h and full fix in the next sprint. Options:
- Option A (fast): Add conservative rehydrate verification + fallback to full state fetch (low-risk patch). Target: hotfix in 24-48h.
- Option B (longer): Deeper KV serialization/state machine rewrite to prevent races (2 sprints).

ryan-eng: Agree. Quick mitigation I can implement: on rehydrate, verify seq_total_tokens against the serialized prefix size; if mismatch > 50 tokens, trigger synchronous fetch of full history and disable async cache write for that session. Put feature flag and rollout 1% then 100%.

olivia-engr: Will help with tests. Need unit test for rehydrate mismatch and an integration test runner that mimics short idle resume. Also add perf test to ensure latency regression <2% for steady state.

emily-cs: HelixAI requests ETA and rollback plan. They prefer minimal downtime.

maya-pm: Draft acceptance criteria for hotfix:
- Reproducer runs end-to-end and confirms prior history retained on resume.
- Unit test covering seq_token mismatch branch.
- Integration test in staging hitting dedicated-like pool.
- Monitoring: alert if rehydrate_fail_rate > 0.5% (baseline 0%).
- Postmortem doc + customer communication drafted.

ryan-eng: Proposed timeline: patch branch today, review tomorrow, canary tomorrow evening (1% traffic), full rollout + monitor within 24h after canary if green. If canary fails, rollback immediately.

triage-bot: RW-5343 moved to status: in-progress.

release-bot: Hotfix pipeline started for RW-5343. CI job 1174 queued.

emily-cs: I'll loop HelixAI PM and propose the canary plan. Also attaching customer's sample request ids to the ticket.

sam-support: Thanks team. Please post status updates here and on the RW ticket.

ryan-eng: I'll post repro logs and a minimal reproducer script to the ticket once I have it.

olivia-engr: Picking this up for test coverage.

maya-pm: Assigning priority: P1-customer-commit. Scope negotiation: prioritize hotfix (Option A), defer Option B to the backlog for deeper fix.

emily-cs: Copy. Will update HelixAI and keep channel open. :handshake:
